verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents tenant tokens as short-lived, scoped credentials generated from an API key that embed search rule filters automatically applied to every request, explicitly ensuring users only see their own data without needing separate indexes per user, and even compares this to Algolia secured keys/PostgreSQL RLS. This is directly first-party documented multitenancy support, though missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of tenant token behavior in production and no community corroboration of this specific security feature.
